_comment: This file contains suggested hooks for Claude Code settings.
_comment2: Copy the desired hooks to your Claude Code settings file.

afterWrite.name: Format Lua files with stylua
afterWrite.description: Auto-format Lua files using stylua after Claude writes them
afterWrite._note: Requires stylua to be installed: cargo install stylua or via Mason in Neovim

afterWrite.name: Validate CHANGELOG format
afterWrite.description: Check that CHANGELOG.md has an [Unreleased] section

beforeCommit.name: Check for TODO comments
beforeCommit.description: Warn if committing files with TODO/FIXME/HACK comments
beforeCommit.command: git diff --cached | grep -i 'TODO\|FIXME\|HACK' && echo 'Warning: Committing files with TODO/FIXME/HACK comments' || true

_notes: Hooks run automatically when certain events occur
Set 'enabled: true' to activate a hook
Use ${filePath} to reference the file being operated on
Hooks can prevent operations by exiting with non-zero status
